title: 第7章 双修蜕变一阳之体第8章突破
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神

冰儿在立春院也有些时间了，知道老妪等人的话，基本不靠谱。
属于用人朝前，不用人朝后的主。
说是帮助自己修行，乃至是帮助寻找妹妹，多半是口头上的敷衍。
所以，在基本确定眼前这位与其他修士有些不同的青年能够激活自己的血脉，她自然是要尽一切努力把握住这个机遇。
李安望着这位极为果决的白发女子，神色也是稍微凝重了一些。
这女子，似乎是觉察到了自己的特殊。
不过这样也好。
眼前这女子同样也是他的机缘！
李安微微点头道：“我叫李安，帮你踏入修行之道，我不能保证，但必然是可以提升你的实力。”
他对立春院这些女子的处境，也是有些了解。
虽然都是牛马，但比他在丹圣宗还要凄惨一些，不仅需要陪客到老，还需要满足一些客人奇怪的要求。
凡是能提升实力，改变处境，她们几乎都会好好争取。
“李安？”
冰儿呢喃着这个名字。
名字平平无奇，不过他的眼神很纯粹，并没有其他客人那般怪异、疯狂，给她一种极端不安的感觉。
她深吸口气，然后就走到案桌前，斟上一杯美酒，送到李安嘴边，
“李公子，这是立春院的上等好酒，你尝尝？”
李安一口喝下，只感觉喉咙一阵火辣，像是燃起了一团烈火。
浑身的气血都是沸腾起来，体内的阳气都被激活起来。

这似乎是鹿血酒。
嗅到李安身上的炙热气息，冰儿脸颊微红，只感觉这股味道有些古怪，但却格外的好闻。
想到接下来要发生的事情，她有些害怕、忐忑，当即给自己也倒上一杯，缓缓喝下。
烈酒入喉，冰儿眼神顿时有些迷离，浑身上下那种特殊的阴气，也如火上浇油。
两人目光对视在一起，一时间，干柴烈火。
李安缓缓伸手，准备抱起身前的绝色佳人。
但当他的手接触到她那如玉般雪白的肌肤时，一缕白虎之气忽然从她身上弥漫而出，传到了李安体内。
李安耳边立刻响起了震耳的虎啸声，心神都在此刻恍惚起来，好似遭受了一记闷棍，整个人晕晕乎乎的。
“李公子，你没事吧？”
见李安差点昏迷过去，冰儿立刻回想起了一些不好的经历。
她生得极美，自然是有一些公子对她垂涎三尺，可是他们刚一接触到自己的身体，就与如今的李安一样，像是受到了什么刺激。
李安晃了晃脑袋，让自己尽可能的清醒一些。
这就是白虎之体的特殊吗？
他有种强烈的预感，强行对冰儿动手，白虎之气入体，只怕是当场就要暴毙！
难怪冰儿在立春楼也有些时间了，结果如今还是银牌的处子。
当即，他神色凝重地望着冰儿身上逸散而出的白虎之气。
炼气境修士，便是依靠各自的功法、体质，博采天地之气化为己用。
而天地之气分上、中、下，共九品！
下九品最低，上一品最高。
而这白虎之气，给李安的感觉，已经达到了上三品的地步！

若非世家大族，仙门奇才，根本不可能修炼出上三品的灵气。

Bing'er had spent some time in Lichun Yuan, and knew that what the old woman and others said was basically unreliable.
It belongs to the master who uses people to face the front and does not use people to face the back.
It was said that it was to help him practice, or even help him find his sister, but it was mostly just perfunctory words.
Therefore, after she was basically sure that the young man in front of her who was somewhat different from other monks could activate her bloodline, she naturally made every effort to seize this opportunity.
Li An looked at this extremely decisive white-haired woman with a slightly more solemn expression.
This woman seems to be aware of her specialness.
But that’s fine too.
The woman in front of him is also his opportunity!
Li An nodded slightly and said: "My name is Li An. I will help you enter the path of cultivation. I can't guarantee it, but it will definitely improve your strength."
He also has some understanding of the situation of these women in Lichunyuan.
Although they are both cows and horses, they are even more miserable than he was in Dan Sheng Sect. Not only do they have to accompany guests until they grow old, but they also have to meet some of the guests' strange requests.
They will almost fight for anything that can improve their strength and change their situation.
"Lee An?"
Binger whispered the name.
His name was unremarkable, but his eyes were pure, not as weird or crazy as other guests, giving her an extremely uneasy feeling.
She took a deep breath, then walked to the desk, poured a glass of wine, and brought it to Li An's mouth.
"Master Li, this is the finest wine from Li Chun Yuan, would you like to try it?"
Li An drank it in one gulp and felt his throat burning, as if a fire had been lit.
The qi and blood all over the body are boiling, and the yang energy in the body is activated.
This appears to be deer blood wine.
Bing'er's cheeks turned slightly red when she smelled the hot breath on Li An's body. She felt that the smell was a little weird, but it smelled particularly good.
Thinking of what was going to happen next, she felt a little scared and uneasy, so she immediately poured herself a glass and drank it slowly.
As the liquor entered her throat, Bing'er's eyes suddenly became blurred, and the special Yin Qi all over her body seemed to add fuel to the fire.
The two people looked at each other, and for a moment, they were in a rage.
Li An slowly reached out and prepared to pick up the stunning beauty in front of him.
But when his hand touched her jade-like snow-white skin, a ray of white tiger aura suddenly spread out from her body and spread into Li An's body.
Li An's ears immediately heard the deafening roar of a tiger, and his mind was in a trance at this moment, as if he had been hit by a sap, and his whole body was dizzy.
"Master Li, are you okay?"
Seeing that Li An almost passed out, Bing'er immediately recalled some bad experiences.
She was extremely beautiful, so naturally some young men coveted her, but as soon as they came into contact with her body, they seemed to be stimulated by something just like Li An now.
Li An shook his head to make himself as awake as possible.
Is this the specialness of the White Tiger's body?
He had a strong premonition that he would forcefully attack Bing'er, and if the White Tiger's energy entered his body, he would die suddenly on the spot!
No wonder Bing'er has spent some time in Li Chun Tower, but now she is still a silver medal virgin.
Immediately, he looked solemnly at the white tiger energy escaping from Bing'er's body.
Qi refining realm monks rely on their own skills and physiques to absorb the energy of heaven and earth for their own use.
The Qi of heaven and earth is divided into upper, middle and lower, a total of nine grades!
The lower ninth grade is the lowest and the upper grade is the highest.
And this white tiger aura gave Li An the feeling that it had reached the third level!
If it weren't for the aristocratic family and the wizards of the immortal sect, it would be impossible to cultivate the spiritual energy of the third grade.
